text_block_list.text:
After the Satsuki Sho, the world shifts its
gaze
from the "top two" to the battle
between the
three powerful members of
"BNW"!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Namely—Бива Хаяхидэ, Нарита Таисин,
and
Уиннинг Тикит.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит challenges Нарита Таисин
to a
scrimmage to prepare for the race
of her
dreams—the Japanese Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Racing against a rival who is striving so

single-mindedly toward her dream
should have a
good effect on Narita
Taishin... But does it really?
text_block_list.name: Монолог
